criteria.given: A fresh Git client checkout with no root AGENTS.md
criteria.when: AskIt installs and the registered Cursor and Codex startup commands run
then: The root AGENTS.md remains absent and the generated runtime files stay local
Both commands load the same kit-owned workflow after a successful access preflight
On access failure each command reports the blocked access and tells the agent to stop project work

criteria.given: A client checkout with its own AGENTS.md and existing Cursor and Codex hooks
criteria.when: AskIt is installed and installed again
then: The client instructions and unrelated editor hook entries are preserved
Each editor has exactly one AskIt startup registration
Existing hook files that cannot be safely updated abort installation without replacing client settings

criteria.given: A client checkout installed by the preceding AskIt release
criteria.when: It is upgraded using the documented migration command
then: Both editor startup commands load the new AskIt workflow
Existing client instructions and unrelated hooks are preserved
